brief:

- the guide's examples, practical ("keeping an appointment, ending an unsafe exchange, eating, sleeping, or handling one neglected task") or relational ("listening without retaliation, admitting where the complaint is true, or repairing after you attack yourself"). Most of them are already in "Not Every Hero Wears A Cape": the envelope, hearing out the sarcasm instead of snapping back, saying so when they're right, apologizing after calling yourself an idiot.
